artworks.title: Study of Trees in a Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on thin brown paper backed with japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing featuring a majestic tree at the center-right. The background includes lightly sketched hills and a small settlement. The tree is detailed with intricate branches and foliage in warm, monochromatic tones. The drawing style is precise with detailed foreground elements and lightly sketched background elements.

artworks.title: A Stand of Trees [recto]
artworks.medium: brush and brown-gray wash with graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch from an aerial perspective. In the lower half, there are dense dark brushstrokes resembling foliage. The horizon is not clearly defined, with a focus on the texture and forms within the brushwork. The technique features loose strokes with an ink wash effect. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. In the upper right corner, there are faint penciled sketches of trees or shrubs.

artworks.title: Study of a Head in Profile [verso]
artworks.medium: gray wash and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays curving lines and arcs in an abstract composition. In the upper left, lines curve inward. To the right, a spiral formation is visible. Below the spiral, linear shapes suggest a horizon or the ribbing of a ship's hull. In the bottom center, a signature appears in brown script.

artworks.title: Landscape Composition [recto]
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The perspective is slightly elevated. The horizon is suggested by a lighter area in the upper third of the composition. The brushwork is loose and fluid, with blends of color. The color palette is warm, mainly shades of brown with hints of cream. The overall impression is of an abstract landscape.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Figure Holding a Basket [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows two full-body sketches of individuals viewed from behind. Both figures are standing with their backs towards the viewer, with one positioned slightly to the left and another to the right. Their facial features are obscured due to the angle, but both are wearing broad-brimmed hats that also obscure their hair. Each figure is dressed in a jacket and pants, and they both carry a sack slung over one shoulder. The sketch is done on a textured paper with faint markings and sketches around the figures, including numbers and letters written vertically near each one. The background consists of the same textured paper surface, without distinct details or features.

artworks.title: The Earth Stopper
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is slightly turned to his right with his hands near his torso. His facial features are outlined, displaying an older face with prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a serious expression. The man's hair is tousled, and he is wearing a large, brimmed hat, a collared shirt with a buttoned coat, and a strap running across his chest. The background is blank.

artworks.title: A Sheep Resting
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor and green crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows a drawing of a sheep lying down facing left. The artist uses delicate lines and subtle shading to illustrate the dense, curly fleece of the sheep, with soft hues of cream and grey. The background is minimalist to emphasize the sheep.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Seated Man
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two men depicted from the waist up. The man on the left is seated with his body turned slightly to the right and his arms crossed. He has curly hair and his facial features, although not detailed, suggest a weathered appearance. He wears a jacket over a shirt with visible buttons. The second man is less detailed and also appears to be seated, turned more directly to the viewer with his arms resting in front of him. He wears similar attire, but his facial and clothing details are not as distinct. Both men’s attire appears to be loose and somewhat casual. In the background, there is no indication of specific surroundings, and the focus is kept on the seated figures with a plain, lightly shaded background.

artworks.title: Study of Death for "Time and Death"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of three figures, each drawn from the waist up. The central figure is slightly tilted to the right, with one arm crossed over the torso. Both figures flanking the central one appear to have their heads slightly bowed. All three are draped in loosely flowing garments, suggested by the light, sketchy lines representing folds and draping fabric. The sketch is done on a light blue background.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing depicting a person shown in profile facing left. The person has their head slightly tilted upwards. The drawing highlights the contours of the nose, lips, and eye, giving a serene and attentive expression. The person has straight, smooth hair pulled back. They appear unclothed from the shoulders up. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a textured surface of brown-toned paper used for the drawing.

artworks.title: An Alpine Landscape with a Couple Seated by Trees Overlooking a Valley
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink on light gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an expansive landscape drawing with distant mountains forming a soft horizon line towards the upper part of the image. The horizon sits relatively low, creating an impression of openness with wide-reaching skies above. Thin, delicate lines depict natural features such as undulating hills and sparse vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of grey tones. In the foreground, there are two wind-blown trees and a figure seated beneath them, looking out at the scenery. Beyond them, in the distance, there are trees and elongated forms suggesting distant hills or fields leading up to the base of the mountains.

artworks.title: Death of a General
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd scene with figures in armor and weapons. The artwork shows a gathering of figures interacting against a backdrop suggesting a setting of conflict. There are spears and shields visible. The figures are arranged dynamically, with some kneeling or gesturing. A central figure is being attended to by others, suggesting a narrative moment. The drawing has detailed expressions and a classical theme, giving it a sense of historical or mythological storytelling.

artworks.title: An Angel
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in a slightly hunched position, with their head turned slightly downward and to one side. The person has curly hair framing their face, with closed eyes and smooth eyebrows. The clothing is loosely draped around their shoulders. Behind the person is a folded wing. The background is simple, drawing focus to the sketched figure and their wing. The drawing has a finished border framing the central image.

artworks.title: Study of a Right Arm and a Left Hand
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two hands and an arm. The drawing features a study of two hands; one hand is at the bottom of the image with spread fingers, while the other is at the upper left, extending outward, connected to an arm covered by fabric. The drawing uses pencil lines to depict the contours, shading for depth, and texture for the skin and fabric. The background is plain beige.

artworks.title: The Reaper (The Harvest Moon)
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing upright. He is facing forward with his head turned slightly upward. He has a youthful appearance with fair skin, short dark hair, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, brown jacket, white shirt, light-colored trousers, tall socks, and shoes. In one hand, he holds a sickle, and in the other hand, a round woven hat. Beside him is a small dog with a brown and white coat. The background consists of a rural landscape under a large, pale sky with a round shape resembling the sun or moon.

artworks.title: Blue Ridge Mountains
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, fields, distant mountains, and a sky with clouds. The painting has a watercolor style with soft brushstrokes, using muted earth tones such as green, brown, and blue. Trees and ground in the foreground lead the eye towards the mountainous horizon under a serene sky with patchy clouds.

artworks.title: Study of a Chair Leg
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate furniture leg. The drawing features a single, detailed leg of a piece of furniture with intricate carving. The leg has an elegant curve and textured surface, suggesting a classical decorative style. The use of pencil provides subtle shadowing and depth against a plain background.

artworks.title: A Family Group
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered together in a room. The drawing features several figures engaged in an activity involving a table. Some figures have well-defined outlines, while others are only suggested by faint strokes. The composition is centered around a table, with figures placed around it in various poses. Light and shadow are used to imply depth and the play of light across the scene. The drawing style is minimalistic yet expressive, with a sense of motion and interaction conveyed through deliberate strokes.

artworks.title: Landscape with Figures and a Carriage
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from a high angle. The horizon is high in the composition, with rolling terrain leading towards it. A small structure is visible in the distance on the left. In the foreground, a person in dark clothing faces away, observing a carriage pulled by two horses. A group of figures is gathered to the left. The artistic style features delicate brushstrokes, creating an ethereal effect. The color palette is muted, with pale blues, soft greens, and hints of beige, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows curved lines and rounded shapes forming an abstract composition. The shapes resemble a gathering of figures or a crowd in a busy public scene, conveying movement and a sense of bustle. The loose, sketchy lines suggest various scenarios such as gatherings in a public square or figures observing an event. The abstract nature of the drawing allows for multiple interpretations, with the loops and curves creating a complex narrative of forms.

artworks.title: An Ornate Ewer [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a large ornate urn or vase decorated with intricate carvings and handles, positioned centrally within the composition. The color palette consists of brown ink on a cream-colored paper, creating a monochrome appearance. The urn is placed vertically in the center of the image, with clear designs like floral motifs and intricate handles visible against a loosely sketched background. The urn's base sits on a surface indicated by a few strokes at the bottom, with other incomplete lines suggesting an unfinished setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Mother and Child [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a partial view of two figures. On the right, an individual is seated, displaying an upper body view, with one arm bent and possibly resting on their lap. The figure is sketched with simplified facial features, without detailed expression, and appears to have short to medium length hair. The clothing of this individual is not detailed, with only basic outlines suggesting garments draped around the body. The left side shows another figure with only a suggestion of the upper body and head, facing towards the seated individual. The background is plain and unadorned, giving no specific context or setting to the scene. There are no objects or jewelry visibly depicted in their hands or on their persons.

artworks.title: An Upraised Arm
artworks.medium: black and red chalks heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person's arm from the shoulder down to the hand. The arm is slightly bent, with the hand gripping a rod or pole. The arm is wearing a long sleeve with a cuff at the wrist. The drawing uses soft lines, shading, and a reddish tone to depict the clothing's texture. The background is plain beige, emphasizing the arm without any distractions. No facial features are visible.

artworks.title: A Tassel
artworks.medium: black, red, and yellow chalks heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a braided motif with decorative elements. The artwork features a loose braid intertwined with an ornamental tassel or knot design. The drawing is rendered in soft graphite, with touches of yellow and hints of pink for shading. The lines are fluid and sketchy, capturing the curves and movement of the braid, and the decorative segment adds a textural contrast with its pattern of dots and crosshatching. The composition focuses on the interplay between curves and textures.
